cost_distribution.interpretation: Histogram and quantiles describe only selected events with available valid observed cost. The unknown-cost count and coverage use all selected events; no unknown cost is imputed.

inspection_methods.share_denominator: All selected retained logged defect events; within-method Critical share uses that method's recorded events.

measurement_requirements.sensitivity: True positives divided by ground-truth-positive units assessed by that method.
measurement_requirements.false_negative_rate: False negatives divided by ground-truth-positive units assessed by that method.
measurement_requirements.specificity: True negatives divided by ground-truth-negative units assessed by that method.
measurement_requirements.false_positive_rate: False positives divided by ground-truth-negative units assessed by that method.
additional_data: Unit-level method outcomes linked to independently assessed ground truth, including missed defects and false positives.

inspection_methods.interpretation: Counts, shares, severity mix and repair costs describe recorded defect events. Inspected-unit exposure, matched ground truth and missed defects are unavailable, so these observations cannot rank inspection effectiveness. Rows are ordered by method label.

top_product_cluster.selection_rule: The first five eligible master products ranked by selected event count, with product_id as the tie-breaker; no high-count product is removed.

recommendations.title: Investigate Critical defects at Component
recommendations.evidence: 148 Critical events among 346 logged events at Component (42.8%).
recommendations.action: Review these defect records with operators, inspect representative failures and verify causes before choosing corrective actions.
recommendations.owner: Quality Engineer and relevant Production Team Leader
recommendations.success_measure: Track Critical events and their share at this location with actual inspected/produced units and comparable inspection coverage; set a target after baseline validation.

recommendations.title: Investigate high-intensity Category 4 products
recommendations.evidence: Category 4: 282 events over 61,410 reference units (4.592 per 1,000 vs 1.473 elsewhere in scope); higher than the rest of the line on 4 of 4 lines.
recommendations.action: Compare design, materials and process steps of the highest-intensity products in this category with lower-intensity products on the same line; review representative failures before changing the process.
recommendations.owner: Process Engineering with Quality Engineer and Production Team Leaders
recommendations.success_measure: Track this category's reference intensity on each line and its ratio to the rest of the line, with Critical share; set a reduction target after actual output is confirmed.

recommendations.title: Investigate repair cost per event on Line-3
recommendations.evidence: Line-3 averages 685.69 known repair cost per event vs 413.35 on other lines (1.66x); 37.4% of linked known cost from 26.5% of linked known-cost events.
recommendations.action: Break down repair cost by repair route, labour, parts and rework with Maintenance; confirm cost-recording rules with Finance; compare the same category on other lines before attributing the gap to the line.
recommendations.owner: Line-3 Team Leader with Maintenance and Finance
recommendations.success_measure: Track average known repair cost per event on this line against other lines for the same category, with cost coverage; set a savings target only after repair-cost records are verified.

issues.description: Slash date can represent more than one date without a source convention.
issues.handling: M/D/YYYY follows the declared dominant source convention; ambiguity is not independently resolved.

issues.description: Same event has a missing cost and one observed cost in otherwise matching rows.
issues.handling: Same event attributes; observed cost from source row 263 retained, not imputed.

issues.description: Duplicate event ID carries contradictory attributes.
issues.handling: Same event ID has contradictory attributes; all variants quarantined pending source owner decision.

issues.description: Unambiguous day-first dates differ from the predominant source convention.
issues.handling: Unambiguous D/M/YYYY exception converted to ISO.

issues.description: Repeated payload rows would inflate event and cost totals.
issues.handling: Identical payload copy of source row 22.

issues.description: Case/whitespace variation fragments known category labels.
issues.handling: Mapped to 'Moderate'; missing/unrecognized categories remain Unknown.

issues.description: Repair cost is absent; financial coverage is incomplete.
issues.handling: Cost is unknown; event retained for nonfinancial counts; no imputation.

issues.description: Negative repair cost is invalid for this cost-incurred field.
issues.handling: Cost is unknown; event retained for nonfinancial counts; no imputation.

issues.description: Same event becomes identical after label normalization.
issues.handling: Identical after documented normalization; retained source row 619.

issues.description: Valid source date lies outside January-June 2024.
issues.handling: Valid date retained in clean snapshot; excluded from January-June 2024 analysis.

issues.description: Product foreign key has no corresponding master row.
issues.handling: Retained in plant totals as Unknown line/category; excluded from linked output intensity.

issues.description: Calendar dates without source events do not establish reporting completeness or operating-day exposure.
issues.handling: Retain observed events; show zero logged events on calendar charts, qualify baseline screening, and request reporting/production calendars.

quality.counting_note: Issue counts can overlap and include removed/out-of-scope source rows; do not add issue counts to reconcile rows.
quality.audit_stage_note: Field checks run after exact-copy removal; raw profile separately counts all received rows. Post-join and date-scope checks run after ID resolution.

definitions.event_count: Unique retained logged defect events in the selected full-month scope, including unmatched products at plant level.
definitions.products_with_events: Distinct product identifiers in the selected logged events, including identifiers unmatched to the product master. This is not the count of eligible master products with events.
definitions.cohort_product_count: Eligible products in the selected product-master cohort, including products with no selected events. Event filters do not shrink this reference cohort.
definitions.linked_event_count: Selected logged events linked to the product master. This counts events, not distinct products.
definitions.unmatched_event_count: Selected logged events without a product-master match. Multiple events can share an unmatched product identifier; this event count cannot be subtracted from a distinct-product count to obtain eligible products with events.
definitions.known_repair_cost: Sum of observed nonnegative repair costs only, in unspecified local currency; not a full cost estimate.
definitions.cost_coverage_pct: Events with known valid repair cost / all selected events × 100.
definitions.reference_intensity_per_1000: Reference-output intensity = linked logged defect events / (sum of monthly_output for all eligible master products × selected full months) × 1,000. Static reference output is not verified actual production; this is not a defect probability. Event filters change the numerator only.
definitions.eligible_event_count: Selected events linked to a product in the complete master cohort; this is the reference-intensity numerator.
definitions.output_coverage_pct: Master products with a valid positive monthly_output / all master products in the selected cohort × 100. Partial output is never used as the total denominator.
definitions.cost_distribution: Distribution of observed valid repair costs among selected events with available costs. Unknown or scenario-withheld costs stay outside the histogram and quantiles; coverage uses all selected events.
definitions.inspection_methods: Recorded defect-event composition by inspection method, with within-method severity and observed-cost coverage. No inspected-unit exposure or ground truth is available to estimate effectiveness.
definitions.cleaning_impact: Raw received rows compared with retained unique events for the complete canonical January-June 2024 scope. Dashboard filters and scenarios do not change this comparison. Cleaning differences do not measure manufacturing improvement.
definitions.decomposition: Group contributions to the comparison-period minus baseline-period difference. Contributions describe accounting changes, not causes. Each group partitions the selected events once.
definitions.critical_share_pct: Critical events / all selected events × 100; Unknown severity remains in the denominator.
definitions.anomalies: Exploratory daily logged-count candidates exceeding a fixed January mean + 3√mean reference. No actual daily exposure or reporting completeness is available; this is not validated statistical process control.
definitions.category_summary: Reference-output intensity by product category over its complete master cohort, with linked events per cohort product as a check that does not depend on the static output denominator.
definitions.shared_category_controls: For a category carried by several lines: its intensity against the rest of the same line, and its observed cost per known-cost event against the same category on other lines. Descriptive mix controls, not causal tests.
definitions.line_cost_comparison: Average observed repair cost per known-cost linked event on each line against all other lines combined, with each line's share of linked known cost and of linked known-cost events.
definitions.period_halves: First half against second half of an even number of selected full months: logged events, Critical events and observed repair cost.
